Web search, page extraction, crawling and site maps for AI agents, plus research reports.

## API key

1. Open [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from app.tavily.com (1,000 free credits a month).

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add tavily
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  tavily: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Tavily's [API](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show tavily` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Pay as you go $0.008 per credit: basic search 1 credit, advanced 2; extract 1 credit per 5 URLs; map 1 per 10 pages.

**Rate limits:** 100 a minute. Development keys 100 per minute, production keys 1,000; crawl 100 and research 20 per minute for both.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Tavily).
